title: EON Office theme (v0 — UNSTABLE)
description: A declarative theme every EON Office application can render: six colours, nothing else. No code, no stylesheet, no URLs — madde 4's rule carried over. The schema checks shape; contrast cannot be expressed in JSON Schema, so the core additionally measures four text pairs (text/background, text/surface, muted/background, accent_text/accent) and refuses any below WCAG 2.1 AA, 4.5:1 (madde 35).

color.description: #rrggbb. One spelling per colour, so themes stay comparable.
